description:
Running a shop through a Facebook Page means orders, comments, campaigns, and Messenger DMs never stop. Seller AutoBusiness is built to run that whole workload on its own: hand it product photos and it writes the listings, builds matching campaigns, drafts posts in your Page's own established voice, and schedules them, then keeps handling orders, comments, and delivery as they come in.

THE PROBLEMS SELLER AUTOBUSINESS HELPS WITH

"Turning product photos into posts takes forever."
Give it product photos and Seller AutoBusiness writes the listings, builds matching marketing campaigns, and schedules Facebook posts for them, written in your Page's own posting style, not a generic template.

"My Facebook comments pile up and I lose sales."
Seller AutoBusiness reads new comments and Messenger messages on your Page and replies to real buyer questions, so interested customers don't go cold waiting for you to notice them.

"I don't know which orders to dispatch today."
See every order status in one place, approve or cancel orders, and hand ready ones straight to Steadfast for pickup without switching apps.

"Replying to every Messenger DM takes all day."
Customer questions about price, stock, and delivery get answered directly in Messenger, pulled from your actual product catalog.

"My Daraz, Shopify, and Facebook stock go out of sync."
Sync your catalog across Daraz, Shopify, and Facebook so the same products and stock levels show up everywhere you sell.

WHAT IT DOES

Photos to posts: turn product photos into full listings, matching campaigns, and scheduled Facebook posts, written in your Page's own voice.
Catalog and campaigns: add products, run discounts, and publish Facebook marketing posts.
Comments and Messenger: reply to Page comments and customer DMs with real catalog answers.
Orders and delivery: track leads, approve orders, and book Steadfast courier pickups.
Multi-channel sync: keep your Daraz and Shopify catalogs matched to your Facebook store.

TRY ASKING
- "Turn these product photos into listings and schedule a week of posts."
- "What orders need dispatching today?"
- "Reply to my new Facebook comments."
- "Sync my Daraz stock with Facebook."

WHO IT'S FOR
F-commerce sellers who want the day-to-day of their Facebook Page store run for them: small online shops and merchants taking orders through Messenger.

GOOD TO KNOW
Owner accounts only. Sign in through standard OAuth; the assistant acts only as you and only on your own store. Courier integration currently supports Steadfast (Bangladesh).
